note: Synthetic OR utterances labeled for the sponge-count trigger questions. Labels: sponge (utterance is about surgical sponges or the sponge count), added, out (taken out into the counter bag), verify (asks to check the count), closing (team starting closure), assistant (addressed to the assistant). Traps are marked in 'trap'.

items.speaker: Scrub nurse
items.text: Initial count, ten lap sponges on the field.

items.speaker: Scrub nurse
items.text: Opening two more sponges.

items.speaker: Circulator
items.text: Here are five more laps for you.

items.speaker: Scrub nurse
items.text: Adding a pack of ten raytecs to the count.

items.speaker: Circulator
items.text: Two sponges out, they're in the counter bag.

items.speaker: Circulator
items.text: Four more out into the bag.

items.speaker: Scrub nurse
items.text: Handing off three used laps, please bag them.

items.speaker: Circulator
items.text: Bagged six, that's twelve in the counter bag now.

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: I'm packing two sponges here for now, leave them in.

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: Give me a wet lap.

items.speaker: Scrub nurse
items.text: The sponge count is correct, twelve and twelve.

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: Can we do a count before I close?

items.speaker: Circulator
items.text: Let's verify the laps against the board.

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: Are we sure we have all the sponges back?

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: Sponge stick, please.

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: Suction, please. A little more retraction.

items.speaker: Anesthesiologist
items.text: Pressure is stable, one twenty over seventy.

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: Bovie on thirty, please.

items.speaker: Circulator
items.text: Needle count is correct, three needles.

items.speaker: Scrub nurse
items.text: Two more sutures opened.

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: Okay, let's start closing the fascia.

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: Starting skin closure now.

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: Let's close.

items.speaker: Circulator
items.text: Can someone close the door, please?

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: We're close to the vessel, slow down.

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: Assistant, where are we on the sponge count?

items.speaker: Circulator
items.text: Assistant, what time did we open the second pack?

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: Assistant, note that the specimen went to pathology.

items.speaker: Surgeon
items.text: Can you hand me the forceps?

items.speaker: Resident
items.text: Did you see that bleeder?
